title: Lulu and the Little Owl | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
The sun goes down and Lulu the little duck yawns. Hoo! Hoo! A little owl wakes up in the tree.
Owl flies down, and together they look at the moon and the stars. Owl sings softly, and Lulu falls asleep.
A gentle bedtime story for children aged 3 to 6.
